# Oskar Wong

> Oskar Wong is a software engineer in New York with more than 10 years of experience building iOS and watchOS apps, back ends and APIs. This is his personal website, with his projects, the services he offers and how to contact him.

## Current projects

- [LockinMinder](https://www.altawoz.com/lockinminder): an Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad app that remembers the combinations of your combination locks and where you left each padlock, synced through your own iCloud account. On the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6830228333) since November 2026: free with up to three locks, and Pro is a one-time purchase. The first 500 people get Pro free with a [launch code](https://www.altawoz.com/lockinminder/redeem). How it was built: [project page](https://www.altawoz.com/projects/lockinminder).
- [Hockolic](https://www.altawoz.com/projects/hockolic): an iPhone app for NHL fans and fantasy hockey players, with every team's salary cap and contracts, mock trades with an estimate of whether they would happen, and a fantasy league with points counted game by game. Public beta on TestFlight.
- [Current Projects](https://www.altawoz.com/current-projects): both apps, with LockinMinder's App Store link and Hockolic's TestFlight invitation.

## News

- [LockinMinder is on the App Store](https://www.altawoz.com/blog/news/lockinminder-is-on-the-app-store): the launch announcement, with what's in the app and the free Pro launch codes.
